data.name: Amatus
data.gender_notes: Amatus is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name that symbolizes love and affection, reminding us of Allah's infinite love for His creation. The name Amatus carries the meaning “Loving” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Amatus usually hope their child will grow to embody loving and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Amatus is considered a name that reflects the love and mercy of Allah.
data.etymology: Amatus belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Loving.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amatus total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: عمة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني خادمة أو جارية في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم 'عمة' مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع-م-ة' والذي يعني الخدمة أو العبودية. في اللغة العربية، 'عمة' تعني خادمة أو جارية. وفي سياق الأسماء الإسلامية، قد يشير إلى العبودية لله تعالى أو الخدمة للآخرين. استخدم هذا الاسم في مختلف الثقافات الإسلامية كدلالة على التواضع والخدمة.

in_urdu.name: عمتوس
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام 'عمتوس' عربی جڑ 'ع-م-ة' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خدمت کرنا یا غلامی. اردو میں، 'عمتوس' کا مطلب خادمہ یا جاریہ ہوتا ہے. اسلامی ناموں کے سیاق میں، یہ نام اللہ تعالی کی عبودیت یا دوسروں کی خدمت کا اشارہ دے سکتا ہے. یہ نام مختلف اسلامی ثقافتوں میں تواضع اور خدمت کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوا ہے.

in_hindi.name: अमातुस
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम 'अमातुस' अरबी जड़ 'ع-م-ة' से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है सेवा करना या दासता. हिंदी में, 'अमातुस' का अर्थ ख़ादिमा या जारिया होता है. इस्लामी नामों के संदर्भ में, यह नाम अल्लाह की दासता या दूसरों की सेवा की ओर संकेत कर सकता है. यह नाम विभिन्न इस्लामी संस्कृतियों में विनम्रता और सेवा के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया गया है.

in_pashto.name: عمتوس
in_pashto.long_meaning: د 'عمتوس' نوم د عربی جڑ 'ع-م-ة' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې د خدمت کولو یا غلامۍ دی. په پښتو کې، 'عمتوس' د خادمې یا جاريې معنی لري. په اسلامي نومونو کې، دا نوم کولای شي د الله تعالی د عبادت یا د نورو د خدمت اشاره وکړي. دا نوم په مختلفو اسلامي کلتورونو کې د تواضع او خدمت د نښې په توګه کارول شوی دی.

in_english.name: Amatus
in_english.meaning: Means servant or slave girl in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Amatus originates from the Arabic root 'ع-م-ة' (ʿ-m-t), meaning 'servant' or 'slave girl'. In Islamic tradition, it signifies servitude to Allah or service to others. Historically used across various Muslim cultures, Amatus symbolizes humility and service. Its usage reflects a rich cultural heritage and spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: While the name "Amatus" is not an Islamic name per se, it does carry a beautiful meaning that resonates with Islamic values. The name is derived from the Latin word "amatus," which means "beloved" or "loved one." In Islamic culture, love and affection towards God and His creations are highly regarded. propagating love and compassion towards others is a fundamental aspect of Islamic teachings. The name "Amatus" can serve as a reminder of the importance of loving relationships and the beautiful bond we share with Allah and His creation.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Amatus" lies in its reminder of Allah's infinite love and compassion for His creation. It is a reminder that we are all beloved children of Allah, deserving of love, kindness, and mercy. The name also serves as a reminder to strive to emulate Allah's love and compassion towards others, treating them with kindness and love. In Islamic tradition, love for Allah is considered the greatest of all loves, and it inspires us to be good to ourselves and others. The name "Amatus" can serve as a daily reminder to cultivate love and compassion in our hearts, fostering peace and harmony within ourselves and in our relationships with others.
